duration.text: The One-semester Chinese Language program at East China Normal University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1361 USD/per semester ￥ 9800 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1) Application form for International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship filled in Chinese or English and generated by online application.2) Copy of passport* Applicants under the age of 18 shall provide certified documents of designation signed by their entrusted legal guardians in China.3) Highest diploma & Academic transcripts (original or notarized photocopy): Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.4) A study or research plan. All applicants are required to submit a study or research plan. It must be in Chinese or in English and no less than 800 words.5) Recommendation letters from recommending Institution.6) Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (The original copy should be kept by the applicant.) The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Please select the appropriate time to take medical examination as it is valid for only 6 months.7) HSK & HSKK Certificate (the Chinese Proficiency Test, Valid for 2 years).* Chinese Bridge' winners who have been awarded International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate are required to log on to the International Chinese Language Teacher Scholarship website and submit their application materials with their scholarship certificate. Should you have any inquiries, please contact at chinesebridge@chinese.cn.8) Non-criminal Certificate (notarized photocopy in English or Chinese)9) Application fee: 800 RMB (Please pay through the online registration at https://lxsapply.ecnu.edu.cn/)

requirements.text: Ages ranging from 16 to 35 (calculated uniformly as of September 1, 2024). The maximum age limit for in-service Chinese teachers maybe extended to 45.Language RequirementApplicants should have a minimum score of 180 in HSK test (Level 4) and HSKK score.Chinese Bridge' winners who have been awarded International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate can apply for admission according to the scholarship specified in the certificate. Please consult chinesebridge@chinese.cn concerning scholarship awarding.
